contact.title: Contact us
paragraphs: For product questions, delivery issues, returns, or account support, sign in to send a private message.

shipping.title: Shipping policy
paragraphs: Free shipping on eligible U.S. orders.

sections.title: Shipping Coverage
sections.text:
We ship eligible products to all 50 U.S. states, including Alaska and Hawaii.

All eligible orders qualify for free shipping, with no minimum purchase requirement.

sections.title: Shipping Methods and Delivery Estimates
sections.text:
We work with multiple shipping carriers depending on the customer's delivery location and shipping requirements.

Our estimated delivery time is 5–7 business days.

Delivery estimates begin after payment has been successfully verified and the order has been dispatched. Actual delivery times may vary depending on the destination, carrier operations, weather conditions and other circumstances beyond our control.

sections.title: Order Processing and Dispatch
sections.text:
Orders are generally processed and dispatched within 24 hours after successful payment verification.

Orders cannot enter the processing and dispatch stage until the required payment has been received and verified.

Customers will receive an order confirmation once their payment has been successfully verified.

sections.title: Order Tracking
sections.text:
Once an order has been shipped, customers will receive an email containing their shipment tracking information.

Customers can use the provided tracking number to monitor the progress of their delivery through the relevant shipping carrier.

Please ensure that your email address is correct when placing an order so that shipping notifications can be delivered successfully.

sections.title: Shipping Address Accuracy
sections.text:
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate shipping address, including:

- Full recipient name
- Street address and apartment or unit number, where applicable
- City, state and ZIP code
- Valid contact information

We are not responsible for delivery problems caused by incomplete or incorrect shipping information provided by the customer.

Please contact customer support as soon as possible if you notice an error in your shipping details.

sections.title: Delayed Deliveries
sections.text:
Although we aim to meet our estimated delivery times, occasional delays may occur due to carrier operations, weather conditions or other unexpected circumstances.

If your order has not arrived within the estimated delivery period, please contact our customer support team for assistance.

sections.title: Lost Shipments
sections.text:
If a shipment appears to be lost, customers should contact our support team.

We will investigate the shipment status with the relevant shipping carrier.

If the package is confirmed to be lost, we will issue a refund for the affected order.

sections.title: Damaged or Incorrect Deliveries
sections.text:
If you receive a damaged or incorrect product, you must notify us within 7 days of delivery.

Please provide:

- Your order ID or proof of purchase.
- Clear photographs showing the damaged or incorrect product.
- Photographs of the original packaging, where relevant.
- A brief description of the issue.

Our support team will review the information and guide you through the resolution process.

Eligible cases will be handled according to our Returns and Refunds Policy.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.text:
For shipping questions, delayed deliveries or tracking assistance, please contact our customer support team.


Business location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA

returns.title: Returns, refunds and cancellations
paragraphs: Request a return through Order Support before sending anything back.

sections.title: Return Window
sections.text:
We offer a 14-day return request period from the date of delivery for eligible products.

Customers must contact our support team or submit an online return request within this period.

A valid order ID or proof of purchase is required for all return requests.

sections.title: Eligible Returns
sections.text:
Returns are accepted for the following situations:

- Defective products.
- Products damaged during delivery.
- Incorrect products received.
- Products that do not match the item ordered due to an error by our store.

Opened electronics may qualify for a return only when they are defective or damaged, or when an incorrect product has been supplied.

Ordinary change-of-mind returns are not included in our standard return eligibility.

sections.title: Product Condition Requirements
sections.text:
Returned products must include:

- Original packaging.
- All original accessories.
- Included components and documentation.
- Any other items supplied with the original product.

Products will be inspected before a return or refund is approved.

For defective, damaged or incorrect products, customers should retain the product and its original packaging until the return process has been completed.

sections.title: Non-Eligible Return Conditions
sections.text:
Returns may be rejected when a product shows signs of:

- Physical damage caused after delivery.
- Liquid damage.
- Misuse or improper handling.
- Unauthorized repairs or modifications.
- Missing original accessories or included components.
- Damage unrelated to the reported issue.

All return decisions are subject to product inspection and applicable consumer protection requirements.

sections.title: How to Request a Return
sections.text:
To request a return:

1. Contact our customer support team or submit an online return request.
2. Provide your order ID or proof of purchase.
3. Explain the reason for the return.
4. Attach clear photographs or other requested evidence when applicable.
5. Wait for return instructions and authorization.

Customers must not ship products back without receiving return authorization from our support team.

Unauthorized returns may be delayed or refused.

sections.title: Return Shipping Costs
sections.text:
For eligible returns involving defective, damaged or incorrect products, our store will cover the applicable return shipping costs.

For any separately approved return outside these categories, the customer may be responsible for return shipping costs.

Any applicable return shipping arrangements will be communicated before the product is shipped back.

sections.title: Product Inspection
sections.text:
All returned products are subject to inspection.

If a returned product does not meet the applicable return conditions, we will contact the customer and explain the inspection findings before making a final decision.

Refunds are processed only after the returned product has been inspected and approved.

sections.title: Refund Methods
sections.text:
Approved refunds may be issued through:

- The original payment method, where supported.
- Store credit, where agreed with the customer.
- Another mutually agreed refund method where necessary.

For Zelle payments, an alternative refund method will be agreed upon with the customer.

sections.title: Refund Processing Time
sections.text:
Once a returned product has been inspected and the refund has been approved, refunds are generally processed within 5–7 business days.

The time required for the funds to appear in the customer's account may vary depending on the payment provider or financial institution.

sections.title: Shipping Charges
sections.text:
Any shipping charges paid by the customer are generally non-refundable unless the return results from an error by our store or applicable law requires otherwise.

Our standard eligible products currently qualify for free shipping.

sections.title: Order Cancellations
sections.text:
Customers may request order cancellation before the order has been dispatched.

Once an order has been dispatched, it can no longer be cancelled under this pre-dispatch cancellation process.

Customers may contact support for assistance with any eligible post-dispatch return.

If an eligible cancellation is approved after payment has been received, the applicable refund will be processed through an agreed refund method.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.text:
For return requests, refund questions or cancellation assistance:


Business location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA

warranty.title: Warranty policy
paragraphs: Manufacturer warranty coverage applies where available.

sections.title: Warranty Coverage
sections.text:
Our store provides manufacturer warranty coverage where available.

We do not provide a separate additional store warranty.

Warranty coverage and duration vary depending on the product and its manufacturer.

Customers should review the individual product listing before purchasing to determine whether manufacturer warranty coverage is available.

Products without manufacturer warranty coverage will be clearly identified on their respective product pages.

sections.title: Warranty Duration
sections.text:
Warranty periods are determined by the applicable manufacturer's warranty terms.

The duration may vary between products, brands and product categories.

Customers should refer to the product listing and applicable manufacturer warranty documentation for specific coverage details.

sections.title: Warranty Start Date
sections.text:
Unless the manufacturer specifies otherwise, the warranty period begins on the product's delivery date.

The delivery date may be used to establish the beginning of the applicable warranty period.

sections.title: Submitting a Warranty Claim
sections.text:
If you experience a product issue that may qualify for manufacturer warranty coverage, contact our customer support team.

Please provide:

- Your order ID or proof of purchase.
- The product's serial number.
- A description of the issue.
- Additional photographs or information if requested.

Our support team will review the information and guide you through the applicable manufacturer warranty procedure.

sections.title: Warranty Claim Inspection
sections.text:
All warranty claims are subject to inspection and the manufacturer's warranty conditions.

The manufacturer may require additional information, product testing or physical inspection before approving a claim.

Submitting a warranty request does not automatically guarantee repair, replacement or another warranty resolution.

sections.title: Warranty Exclusions
sections.text:
Manufacturer warranty coverage generally does not include the following circumstances, subject to the specific manufacturer's terms:

- Physical damage.
- Accidental damage.
- Liquid or water damage.
- Unauthorized repairs or modifications.
- Damage resulting from misuse or improper handling.
- Normal wear and tear.
- Cosmetic damage that does not affect product functionality.

Additional exclusions may apply depending on the manufacturer's warranty documentation.

sections.title: Warranty Resolution
sections.text:
Approved warranty claims will be handled according to the manufacturer's applicable warranty procedure.

Depending on the manufacturer and product, available resolutions may include:

- Product repair.
- Product replacement.
- Another resolution provided under the manufacturer's warranty terms.

The availability of each resolution depends on the applicable warranty conditions.

sections.title: Warranty Shipping Costs
sections.text:
Shipping expenses associated with warranty claims will be determined according to the manufacturer's warranty terms.

Customers will be informed of the applicable shipping arrangements during the claim process.

sections.title: Rejected Warranty Claims
sections.text:
If a warranty claim is rejected, we will explain the reason for the rejection to the customer.

The product will be returned to the customer according to the applicable manufacturer procedure and shipping arrangements.

A rejected warranty claim does not automatically qualify for a return or refund under our Returns and Refunds Policy.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.text:
For warranty assistance or questions about manufacturer coverage:


Business location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA

payment.title: Payment policy
paragraphs: Zelle is available at checkout with manual bank verification. PayPal is Temporarily Unavailable.

sections.title: Accepted Payment Methods
sections.text: Customers can pay using Zelle with manual verification. Follow the recipient instructions and exact order total shown during checkout, then submit your transaction reference. Full payment must be verified in the business bank account before processing begins. PayPal is visible at checkout as Temporarily Unavailable and cannot be submitted. Credit/debit card payments are unavailable.

sections.title: Zelle Payment Verification
sections.text:
Customers choosing Zelle as their payment method must complete the payment using the payment instructions provided during checkout or by our store.

Customers may be asked to provide a payment screenshot or transaction confirmation for verification.

A submitted screenshot alone does not constitute successful payment.

Our team must manually verify that the payment has been successfully received before confirming the order.

Customers should never send payments to an unverified payment recipient.

sections.title: Order Confirmation
sections.text:
An order is considered confirmed after successful payment verification.

Payment verification is required before an order enters the processing and dispatch stage.

Customers will receive an order confirmation once the payment has been verified.

All orders remain subject to product availability, pricing accuracy and our order acceptance terms.

sections.title: Pending Payments
sections.text:
If a payment cannot be verified, the order will remain pending until the payment is successfully confirmed.

Customers may be contacted if additional payment information or clarification is required.

Orders will not be processed or dispatched while payment remains unverified.

sections.title: Refunds and Payment Methods
sections.text: Approved refunds follow our Returns, Refunds and Cancellations Policy. For Zelle payments, support will agree on a refund method with the customer. Posting times vary by financial institution.

sections.title: Zelle Payment Notice
sections.text:
Zelle is a payment service and does not provide purchase protection for ordinary purchases of goods and services.

Customers should review the payment instructions carefully and ensure they are paying the correct recipient.

Our store's return, refund and warranty policies apply independently of the payment service's features and limitations.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: This policy describes how the store handles customer information.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.text:
We may collect the following customer information when customers visit our website, place orders or contact our support team:

- Full name.
- Email address.
- Phone number.
- Shipping address.
- Order information and purchase history.
- Payment transaction details and payment verification information.
- Information provided through customer support requests.
- Information required to process returns, refunds and warranty claims.

We collect information necessary to operate our store and provide our services.

sections.title: How We Use Customer Information
sections.text:
Customer information is used for legitimate store operations, including:

- Processing and managing orders.
- Verifying payments.
- Arranging shipping and delivery.
- Sending order confirmations and tracking notifications.
- Responding to customer support inquiries.
- Processing returns and refunds.
- Handling manufacturer warranty claims.
- Maintaining transaction and order records.

We do not use customer information for purposes unrelated to our store operations without an appropriate legal basis.

sections.title: Sharing Customer Information
sections.text:
We do not sell customer personal information to third parties.

However, certain information may be shared with service providers when necessary to operate our store, including:

- Payment processors.
- Shipping and delivery carriers.
- Website hosting and technical service providers.
- Services required for store operations and customer support.

Such information is shared only to the extent necessary for the relevant service or business operation.

Service providers may process information according to their own applicable privacy policies and contractual obligations.

sections.title: Payment Information
sections.text: Zelle transfers are completed through the customer’s bank. The store may retain transaction references and relevant payment information for verification, order records, refunds and financial administration.

sections.title: Promotional Emails
sections.text:
We may send customers promotional emails about products, offers and store updates.

Promotional emails will include an unsubscribe option.

Customers may unsubscribe from promotional communications at any time.

Unsubscribing from marketing emails will not prevent us from sending necessary transactional communications, such as order confirmations, shipping updates and warranty-related notifications.

sections.title: Information Security
sections.text:
We take reasonable steps to protect customer information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and misuse.

However, no electronic storage or internet transmission method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

Customers should avoid sharing sensitive payment information through unsecured communication channels.

sections.title: Customer Privacy Requests
sections.text:
Customers may contact our support team to ask questions about their personal information or request assistance with applicable privacy rights.

Requests will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.text:
We may update this Privacy Policy when our business practices, services or applicable legal requirements change.

Any updated version will be published on our website with a revised Last Updated date.

terms.title: Terms of service
paragraphs: These terms apply alongside the store’s shipping, returns, payment and warranty policies.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.text:
By accessing or using our website and purchasing products from our store, customers agree to comply with these Terms of Service and the applicable store policies.

These terms should be read together with our Shipping, Returns and Refunds, and Warranty Policies.

sections.title: Product Information
sections.text:
We make reasonable efforts to ensure that product descriptions, images, specifications and prices displayed on our website are accurate.

However, product information may occasionally change or contain errors.

Customers are encouraged to review product specifications and individual warranty details before placing an order.

sections.title: Pricing and Availability
sections.text:
All products are subject to availability.

We reserve the right to correct pricing errors, update product information and modify product availability.

If a product is listed at an incorrect price or is unavailable, we may cancel the affected order.

If payment has already been received for an order that is cancelled for these reasons, an applicable refund will be issued.

sections.title: Payment and Order Acceptance
sections.text:
Full payment is required before order processing.

An order is considered confirmed after successful payment verification.

However, all orders remain subject to availability, accurate pricing and review for suspected fraudulent activity.

We reserve the right to reject or cancel an order where there is an incorrect price, unavailable stock or suspected fraudulent activity.

Customers will be notified if an order cannot be fulfilled.

sections.title: Customer Responsibilities
sections.text:
Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete information when placing an order.

This includes:

- Correct name and contact details.
- Valid email address.
- Complete shipping address.
- Accurate order and payment information.

We are not responsible for delivery problems resulting from incorrect information supplied by the customer.

sections.title: Order Cancellation
sections.text:
Customers may request cancellation before their order has been dispatched.

Once an order has been dispatched, the cancellation process is no longer available.

Any eligible post-dispatch return must follow our Returns and Refunds Policy.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.text:
Unless otherwise stated, website content, including product descriptions, graphics, logos, text and website design elements, may be protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

Customers may not reproduce or commercially use protected website content without appropriate authorization.

sections.title: Limitation of Responsibility
sections.text:
We are not responsible for circumstances beyond our reasonable control that affect delivery or service availability, including carrier disruptions, severe weather and other unexpected operational interruptions.

Nothing in these Terms is intended to exclude or limit rights or remedies that cannot legally be excluded or limited under applicable law.

sections.title: Changes to These Terms
sections.text:
We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service when necessary.

Changes will be published on our website, together with an updated Last Updated date.

Continued use of the website after updated terms become effective is subject to applicable law.

sections.title: Applicable Law
sections.text:
These Terms are intended for customers purchasing from our United States-serving online store.

Applicable consumer protection laws and other mandatory legal requirements will govern where they apply.

The governing law and dispute resolution provisions will be specified once the store's legal business details have been finalized.

sections.title: Contact and Business Information
sections.text:
Use the website contact form for questions about payments, privacy, orders or these terms.

Business location: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, USA.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
paragraphs: Find quick answers about accounts, orders, delivery and product support.

sections.title: How do I place an order?
sections.text: You can browse without signing in. When ordering is available, choose a purchasable option, add it to the cart, and sign in to review shipping and the final total.

sections.title: How do I sign in?
sections.text: Use your email and password or choose Google on the account page. If you register by email, follow the verification link sent to your inbox.

sections.title: Which payment methods can I use?
sections.text: Zelle is available with manual bank verification. PayPal is Temporarily Unavailable and cannot be selected for payment. The payment selector shows the methods available for your order.

sections.title: Does an order number mean my payment is confirmed?
sections.text: An order reference identifies your order. Open Order Support to see the separately verified payment status.

sections.title: How do I track a shipment?
sections.text: Sign in and open your order history. Carrier and tracking details appear when they are available for your order.

sections.title: How do I request a return or refund?
sections.text: Send a private message with your order number and reason. Support will explain eligibility and the return instructions for that order.

sections.title: What warranty applies to my item?
sections.text: Coverage depends on the exact product and the terms that apply to your order. Keep your proof of purchase and use Order Support to ask about a claim.

sections.title: How do I contact support?
sections.text: Sign in and use the private contact form. Include your order number when asking about an order.

sections.title: Where can I find current deals?
sections.text: Open Deals & bundles or look for a promotional price on an eligible product. Offers depend on the selected model, variant, stock and campaign dates. The checkout server checks eligibility again before payment.

sections.title: How much is the iPhone discount?
sections.text: During the approved campaign, eligible iPhones receive 15% off their regular selling price. The product page shows the savings for your selected variant. An expired or unavailable offer is not applied.

sections.title: Can I combine discounts?
sections.text: No. Promotions do not stack. Checkout applies the best eligible offer to your selection; adding several products does not automatically create an extra discount.

sections.title: Why does a Daily Deal timer reset?
sections.text: Daily Deal timers count down to midnight Eastern Time and reset each day while the campaign is active. The current campaign ends at midnight Eastern on January 2, 2027, so January 1 is included. The daily timer does not mean an additional discount.

sections.title: Will my selected colour or storage change the deal price?
sections.text: It may change the regular price and available stock. Choose your colour and storage first, then review the corresponding regular price, discounted price and savings. Only available variants can be ordered.

sections.title: Does a sale change shipping charges?
sections.text: Standard shipping is free to all 50 U.S. states. Fast delivery adds $25 per order. Review the final order total before making your payment.

sections.title: Is my discount reserved just by browsing or adding to cart?
sections.text: No. Browsing and cart prices are estimates. Offers must still be active and eligible when your order is placed. Review the final order total and payment instructions before sending funds.

about.title: Good technology. A clearer choice.
paragraphs: Coastline Device Co. brings phones, Apple audio, gaming PCs and PlayStation hardware together in one considered collection. Our aim is simple: help you understand what you are buying and choose the technology that fits your everyday life.

sections.title: Quality starts with the details
sections.text:
The right product starts with the right information. Explore each model’s specifications, storage, finish and configuration before choosing. Product photographs help you take a closer look, while the selected variant determines the price and availability shown on the page.

If a detail matters to your purchase, ask us before ordering. We would rather help you make an informed choice than leave you guessing.

sections.title: Trust through clear information
sections.text:
A good shopping experience should feel straightforward. We show your order total before payment, explain the available delivery options and keep your order status in your account. Promotional prices show the regular price and savings so you can understand the offer.

For Zelle orders, submitting a reference is separate from confirming payment. Our team verifies receipt of funds before marking an order paid and beginning processing.

sections.title: Support beyond your selection
sections.text:
Questions about a model, an order or a delivery deserve a clear next step. Sign in to use our private contact form and include your order number when you need order support. Shipping, returns and warranty information are available before you buy.

Our focus is on useful products, accurate details and communication you can follow—from your first comparison to checking your shipment.
